script:
In another archived recording titled Space #1000, Angela told the audience that she trusted me so much she had given me the names of two military witnesses as her "contingency" in case anything ever happened to her.

"But you gotta stop telling people that I have the stuff because—"

"It defeats the purpose."

"I would never do that."

What I remember is that Angela was comfortable saying I held sensitive information for her. We trusted each other enough to talk privately, in ways I did not expect would become material for public arguments.

By the spring of 2026, Sav had become part of the same circle of friends I was in.

In May, she was going through a difficult separation and facing eviction with her children.

Another host named Shane and I organized a marathon charity Space. Together, we raised $400 to help Sav keep her home.

She was incredibly grateful. That night, she messaged Angela about the help she'd received. The following day, she thanked Angela for bringing her into the community where she'd met me.

At that point, Angela was someone both of us trusted.

We shared personal things with her. Things we never expected to become part of a public argument.

During our friendship, when someone online tried to dig into my past, I confided in Angela about a painful breakup I'd gone through two years earlier in Mississippi with an ex-girlfriend named Natalie. Angela listened like a caring friend.

After the friendship broke down, Angela said in a confrontation that she had spoken with Natalie, my former partner. I cannot establish from that sentence what Natalie told her, or how contact was made.

The recording replayed in the Fan Club Space cuts an important part of the original sentence. Here is the first-generation Deacon conversation, with the missing context restored.

She said she had talked with Natalie and connected that to what she was setting up for court. That is not proof she secretly tracked anybody down or proof of what Natalie said.

There is another conversation with Sav in which two of Angela’s statements are worth hearing together. First, this promise:
